verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः
स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः
verses.tr: Krishna said: One who does the work that should be done without depending on its results is a renunciant and a yogi, not one who merely gives up the sacred fire or all activity.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव
verses.tr: What people call renunciation, know that to be yoga, Arjuna. No one becomes a yogi without giving up selfish plans.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: For the sage who wishes to climb to yoga, action is said to be the means. For the same person, once they have reached yoga, calm is said to be the means.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: When a person is attached neither to sense objects nor to actions, and has given up all selfish plans, they are said to have reached yoga.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Lift yourself up by your own effort; do not let yourself sink. You alone are your own friend, and you alone are your own enemy.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: For one who has mastered themselves, the self is a friend. For one who has not, the self acts like an enemy.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: For one who has mastered themselves and is at peace, the Supreme Self stays steady through cold and heat, pleasure and pain, honour and insult.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: The yogi who is satisfied with knowledge and experience, unshaken, master of the senses, and who sees a lump of earth, a stone and gold as the same, is called steady.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Even better is one who looks equally on well-wishers, friends, enemies, strangers, neutral people, the hateful, relatives, the good and the wicked.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: The yogi should keep the mind steadily on the Self, staying in a quiet place, alone, with mind and body controlled, expecting nothing and holding on to nothing.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: In a clean place, set up a steady seat for yourself, neither too high nor too low, covered with kusha grass, a deerskin and a cloth, one over the other.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Sitting there, making the mind one-pointed and controlling thoughts and senses, practise yoga to purify yourself.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Holding the body, head and neck straight and still, steady, gaze at the tip of your nose without looking around in any direction.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः
verses.tr: Calm and fearless, firm in self-discipline, controlling the mind, sit with your thoughts on me, making me your goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Always practising like this, with the mind controlled, the yogi reaches the peace that rests in me, the supreme stillness of nirvana.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Yoga is not for one who eats too much or too little, Arjuna, nor for one who sleeps too much or stays awake too much.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: For one who is balanced in eating and recreation, balanced in effort at work, and balanced in sleep and waking, yoga removes all sorrow.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: When the disciplined mind rests in the Self alone, free from longing for any pleasure, then one is said to be steady in yoga.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता
verses.tr: "Like a lamp in a windless place that does not flicker": that is the image used for the yogi whose mind is controlled and who is absorbed in meditation.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: When the mind, held still by yoga practice, comes to rest, and seeing the Self by the self, one is content in the Self,

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः
verses.tr: when one knows that boundless joy which is grasped by the intellect and lies beyond the senses, and resting there never moves from the truth,

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः
verses.tr: having gained which one thinks no other gain is greater, and resting in which one is not shaken even by great sorrow,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: know that to be yoga: freedom from all union with sorrow. This yoga should be practised with determination and without losing heart.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Giving up completely all desires born of selfish plans, and drawing in the senses from every side by the mind,

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्
verses.tr: little by little become still, with an intellect held firm by patience. Settling the mind in the Self, think of nothing else.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Wherever the restless, unsteady mind wanders off, bring it back from there and place it under the control of the Self.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Supreme joy comes to the yogi whose mind is at peace, whose restlessness is calmed, who is free from fault and has become one with Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Practising like this always, the yogi, free from fault, easily enjoys the boundless joy of contact with Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: One who is united in yoga sees the Self in all beings and all beings in the Self, and sees the same everywhere.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति
verses.tr: One who sees me everywhere and sees everything in me is never lost to me, and I am never lost to them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते
verses.tr: The yogi who, established in oneness, worships me as dwelling in all beings lives in me, however they may be living.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः
verses.tr: One who sees, by comparing with themselves, that pleasure and pain are the same for all, Arjuna, is considered the highest yogi.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
skt: एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात् स्थितिं स्थिराम्
verses.tr: Arjuna said: Krishna, this yoga of evenness you have described: because the mind is so restless, I do not see how it can last.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
skt: चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्
verses.tr: The mind is restless, Krishna: turbulent, strong and stubborn. Controlling it seems to me as hard as controlling the wind.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते
verses.tr: Krishna said: Without doubt, Arjuna, the mind is restless and hard to control. But it can be held by practice and by letting go of attachment.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः
verses.tr: In my view, yoga is hard to reach for one who has not mastered themselves. But one who is self-controlled and keeps trying can reach it by the right means.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
skt: अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति
verses.tr: Arjuna said: What happens, Krishna, to one who has faith but does not try hard enough, whose mind wanders from yoga before reaching its goal?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.tr: Fallen from both, does he not perish like a scattered cloud, without support, Krishna, lost on the path to Brahman?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.tr: Krishna, please remove this doubt of mine completely. There is no one but you who can remove it.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Krishna said: Arjuna, there is no ruin for such a person, either in this world or the next. No one who does good ever comes to a bad end, my friend.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Having reached the worlds of the virtuous and lived there for many years, the one who fell from yoga is born into a pure and prosperous family.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Or they are born into a family of wise yogis. Such a birth is very rare in this world.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन
verses.tr: There they regain the understanding they had in their previous life, and from there they strive again, even harder, for perfection, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: By that earlier practice they are carried forward, even without trying. Even one who only wishes to know yoga goes beyond mere ritual.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: But the yogi who strives with effort, cleansed of faults and perfected over many births, then reaches the supreme goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: The yogi is greater than those who practise austerities, greater even than the learned, and greater than those who perform rituals. So be a yogi, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः
verses.tr: And of all yogis, the one who worships me with faith, with their inner self absorbed in me, I consider the most united with me.
